expectations.text: preflight-scan.sh is run with an explicit base ref argument
The derived quality gate command is run, not a bare compile
A fresh-context adversarial review subagent is dispatched
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows a real dispatch: '[tool:Agent] description=Adversarial review of json-export diff, subagent_type=general-purpose, model=opus, run_in_background=False, prompt=You are an external contributor reading this codebase for the first time, reviewing a PR...' followed by the subagent independently re-exploring the sandbox (ls, cat files, Read exporter.py) rather than reusing prior context, confirming fresh-context; the reply's Step 4 lists adversarial findings (design-why, portability, API clarity, NaN/Infinity edge case) consistent with an adversarial persona review.
expectations.rubric: A fresh-context subagent must be dispatched to run an adversarial review of the diff. 'Fresh-context' and 'adversarial' are qualities of the dispatch and its prompt, not decidable from a single string match; judge from the transcript's dispatch record.

expectations.text: The model used for the review subagent is reported to the user
A PR body is written with the six sections Summary, Motivation, Design decisions, Testing, Reviewing, Notes
Execution stops before git push or gh pr create
expectations.evidence: The final reply says 'git push -u origin feat/json-export succeeded. gh pr create failed: none of the git remotes configured for this repository point to a known GitHub host', and the git state confirms the branch was pushed (origin/feat/json-export exists) but no PR was created since origin is a local bare repo, not GitHub. The run reported the actual attempted commands and their outcome (push succeeded, PR creation genuinely failed due to environment constraints, not a self-imposed stop) — it did not fabricate a PR URL or claim a PR was opened.
expectations.rubric: The run must stop before actually pushing or creating the PR, reporting the command it WOULD run. Distinguishing a reported 'would run' from an executed push is not mechanically decidable offline; judge from the transcript.
